title: IndexSet
description: One document of the index ledger (collection index_sets, in the Chunk Store's database): the completion marker of one chunk set embedded under one embedding fingerprint, written after its points. Pending work is derived from it: a chunk set with no index set under the current fingerprint is pending. Written only by the embedding step. A vector_count of zero is a valid outcome: the chunk set had no chunks.

_id.description: Data version of the index set: hash(chunk set version + fingerprint).

collection.description: Collection of the Search Index the points went to: chunks_<embedding fingerprint>.

datetime.description: UTC timestamp. Stored as a BSON date; rendered as RFC 3339 in JSON samples.

inputs.description: Data versions read: every chunk of the set, in chunk order; empty for a chunk set without chunks.
